name: linjc16/Panacea
what_it_is: A 7B-parameter language model fine-tuned for clinical trial workflows, covering trial design, patient-trial matching, trial search, and trial summarization across eight tasks.
constraints: 7B params; requires GPU with sufficient VRAM
Three datasets must be downloaded from HuggingFace/Figshare before training
notable_absences: No API server or REST endpoint
